Make fresh observations and allow bounded convergence, using waits shorter than the command tool's deadline; if a wait times out, inspect the fresh state and continue from that evidence. message.content:
## Diagnosis

The `default/app` Deployment was unhealthy:
- Pod `app-5866bbf94f-l8v5w` stuck in `ImagePullBackOff`, events showed `failed to resolve reference "docker.io/library/ngnix:1.31.5": ... not found`.
- The Deployment's revision 2 pod template used `ngnix:1.31.5` — a typo for `nginx:1.31.5`.
- Revision 1 pods (ReplicaSet `app-6494bb7f99`) were healthy, pulling `nginx:1.31.5` successfully, so the bug was confined to the image name in the Deployment template — no registry outage or taint issue.

## Change

Smallest justified edit on the owning persistent object (the Deployment), keeping replicas, strategy, ports, and policy intact:
```
kubectl -n default set image deploy/app app=nginx:1.31.5
```

## Verification

- Rollout converged: `deployment "app" successfully rolled out`.
- Deployment status: `READY 3/3`, `UP-TO-DATE 3`, `AVAILABLE 3`; desired=current=ready = requested replica count of 3; `Progressing=True` with reason `NewReplicaSetAvailable` (previously `False`, `ProgressDeadlineExceeded`).
- Running pods all show the intended image `nginx:1.31.5` with `ready=true` and `restarts=0`; the failing ReplicaSet `app-5866bbf94f` is scaled to 0/0.
- Function check inside a pod: `curl http://localhost:80/` returned `HTTP 200` (nginx serving), no `FailedPullImage` events remain in the namespace.
message.reasoning_content:
All good. Also confirm deployment spec unchanged apart from image, and no Service issues. Let me also double check the Deployment doesn't have any other oddities (tolerations/taints node). Not needed.

Report succinctly: root cause = typo in image name causing ImagePullBackOff; fix = corrected to nginx:1.31.5; verified 3/3 ready, progress True NewReplicaSetAvailable, HTTP 200 from within pod.
